reason: v7-v15 repeatedly accepted the brief, terrain, catalogue and siting stages but full E cuboid proposals remained invalid despite bounded retries and geometry guidance. This separate diagnostic switches only E to a versioned compact blueprint: DeepSeek chooses concept, materials, road-facing entry side and room programme; a local deterministic projector builds a minimal single-storey, one-room shell and route, then the original strict E validator and F review still run. No old response or failure is overwritten. This intentionally trades shape freedom for a verifiable small-case API-to-WIR flow; it is not a general building designer.
scope: One single-storey timber house under the existing A-D and F 0.1.0 contracts plus compact E sub-contract 0.1.1-e-shell. Multi-storey, multi-room, windows and arbitrary buildings are outside this diagnostic.
sample_policy: One run only; all started calls count, including schema, semantic, geometry, budget and export failures. Preserve v1-v15. Any further paid retry requires a new pre-registered batch.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect exactly one single-storey timber house, a street-facing connected entry and one reachable interior room. Report the compact-shell visual limitations. Target import and actual walking remain separate evidence levels.
success.report: Record calls, projected E response, normalizations, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not four-case or population reliability evidence.

cases.prompt: 在一块32米见方的平坦区域内，沿一条可步行的街道建造一栋单层木屋。木屋需要一个面向街道的入口和一间能够从街道进入的室内房间。
